title: Standard WOFOST rate lifetime and legacy carryover reconciliation

general_rule.decision: WOFOST rates are event-local unless a later accepted crop event reads a value that legacy intentionally or accidentally leaves from the prior event

source_facts: glai assigns r%glaiex only while s%laiexp < 6
update_wofost adds r%glaiex*delt to s%laiexp on every standard update
r_act and r_pot are SAVE objects and reset_wofost_rates is not a daily reset
source_bound_cross_event_exceptions.cross_event_effect: after LAIEXP reaches or exceeds 6, the last computed GLAIEXP remains live and continues to change committed LAIEXP on later daily calls
source_bound_cross_event_exceptions.observable_physical_state_affected: LAIEXP, which is already qualified as committed primary actual biomass state in F-WOF23
source_bound_cross_event_exceptions.minimum_storage_rule: for exact B1.10 continuation, retain one scalar only once the actual trajectory enters the LAIEXP>=6 carryover regime; before that threshold the rate is recomputed from current inputs and need not persist
source_bound_cross_event_exceptions.initialization: canonical zero before any computed carryover exists; capture the current event's computed GLAIEXP when the candidate first enters the carryover regime
source_bound_cross_event_exceptions.transaction_semantics: candidate-local; rejected events cannot change the committed carryover value
source_bound_cross_event_exceptions.alternative_not_admitted_here: resetting GLAIEXP to zero after the threshold would be a theory/code correction requiring separate scientific qualification against the legacy oracle

source_facts: update_dvs_rate resets/assigns vernrate only while fl_vernalised is false
wofost task 3 adds vernrate to vern after the actual/potential biomass updates on every IDSL=2 daily call
if saturation makes fl_vernalised true after a positive vernrate, the next call bypasses the reassignment but still adds the saved value
source_bound_cross_event_exceptions.cross_event_effect: legacy VERN can continue increasing after saturation-driven vernalization completion
source_bound_cross_event_exceptions.future_standard_DVS_feedback_after_compl: none found because fl_vernalised bypasses the vernalization reduction on subsequent standard-route phenology evaluations
source_bound_cross_event_exceptions.observable_state_affected: VERN is written by legacy WOFOST output and is part of the requested IDSL=2 continuation state
source_bound_cross_event_exceptions.minimum_storage_rule: retain one scalar only for IDSL=2 trajectories where a nonzero carryover must be reproduced; forced completion at VERNDVS canonically leaves/sets a zero carryover
source_bound_cross_event_exceptions.transaction_semantics: optional candidate-local memory; rejected events cannot change it
source_bound_cross_event_exceptions.alternative_not_admitted_here: forcing vernrate to zero after completion would be a theory/code correction requiring separate scientific qualification

non_state_saved_value.finding: GLA can also remain stale when LAIEXP>=6, but no scoped standard-route feedback or committed-state update consumes that stale GLA after the conditional block

state_model_refinement.supersedes_initial_blanket_hypothesis: The initial F-WOF25 readiness contract listed vernrate and WOFOST_rates as non-committed rates. Source audit refines that hypothesis: the full rate object remains non-state, but two scalar prior-event values have source-bound continuation effects under narrow conditions.
compatibility_memory_scaling: GLAIEXP carryover only for active actual-WOFOST trajectories in the carryover regime
VERNRATE carryover only for IDSL=2 where required
inactive crops and unrelated execution classes allocate neither
